'''Armoured zombies''' are monsters that appear throughout the first, third and fourth of [[The Shadow Reef]]. They are similar to their [[Zombie (The Shadow Reef)|unarmoured counterparts]], except the armour they wear allows them to take more hits before dying.

As undead, they are susceptible to the effects of the [[salve amulet]] and its [[salve amulet (e)|enhanced version]], the [[Undead Slayer]] perk and effects of the [[Undead Slayer (ability)|Undead Slayer]] ability.

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}

In story mode, only bones are dropped.

The average armoured zombie kill in normal mode is worth:
* Floor 1: {{NoCoins|{{#expr:{{#vardefineecho:avg_drop_val|{{Average drop value|mob=Armoured zombie (The Shadow Reef)#Normal mode|raw=y}}}}+{{Average drop value|mob=Armoured zombie (The Shadow Reef)#Normal mode (Floor 1)|raw=y}}}}}} coins.
* Floor 2: {{NoCoins|{{#expr:{{#var:avg_drop_val}}+{{Average drop value|mob=Armoured zombie (The Shadow Reef)#Normal mode (Floor 2)|raw=y}}}}}} coins.
* Floor 3: {{NoCoins|{{#expr:{{#var:avg_drop_val}}+{{Average drop value|mob=Armoured zombie (The Shadow Reef)#Normal mode (Floor 3)|raw=y}}}}}} coins.
